subject: Seed program promotional terms — extension request
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@nimbusteam.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Seed program promotional terms — extension request

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Nimbus Labs is excited about the latency profile and the cost projections you shared. We have a quick ask from our founders and ops team: the accelerator program's promotional credits (the 6-month $10k onboarding credit) will expire before our product launch window. Can Redwood provide a short extension or a partial makegood if we miss the activation window?

Proposed asks from our side:
- 60-day extension on the $10k onboarding credit OR a one-time $3k activation credit if we sign by end of Q3.
- A 30% introductory discount on the first paid month (to help bridge usage patterns).

I've attached the term sheet the accelerator sent along so you can see timing constraints. We should be able to move quickly if there's a path.

[Attachment: term-sheet-nimbus-v2.pdf (PDF, 243KB)]

Looking forward — happy to hop on 15 mins today.

Best,
Emma Li
Head of Platform | Nimbus Labs
emma@nimbusteam.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@nimbusteam.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seed program promotional terms — extension request

Hi Emma — thanks for the note and for sending the term sheet. This is something we can usually support but it needs a couple of guardrails so we don't create an open-ended precedent. Quick summary of what I can offer right now (pending internal approval):

- Option A (preferred): 60-day extension on the $10k onboarding credit if Nimbus signs the MSA and issues a PO within 30 days of the extended activation date.
- Option B: If activation window is missed and there is a verified launch delay, Redwood will provide a one-time $2.5k activation credit (we can flex to $3k if legal approves).
- Introductory discount: we can commit to a 20% discount on the first paid month, not 30%, to avoid distortion of unit economics for churny proofs.

If you can accept Option A with the 20% starter discount, I will escalate to my manager for promo approval and ask finance to pre-authorize the billing flow. I attached a draft mutual action plan so we can lock milestones and the PO timeline.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm which option you prefer and upload any PO/accelerator confirmation.
2) I loop in Lauren for formal promo sign-off and Marissa for commercial setup.
3) We produce an addendum to the MSA documenting the extension and activation conditions.

[Attachment: mutual_action_plan_draft.xlsx (XLSX, 18KB)]

Happy to jump on a short call — are you available 2pm PT today?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0172
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seed program promotional terms — extension request

Looping in as requested. Rishi — this is an ok exception window for a seed/accelerator account under the following constraints: 

- Promo approval: one-time exception to extend onboarding credit by 60 days provided Nimbus signs MSA + issues PO within 30 days of the extended activation date.
- Financial guardrails: the activation credit will be invoiced as a contra-revenue line item; Finance needs the PO and an internal promo code (I will request).
- Discount: I can approve up to 25% for the first paid month on a 3-month minimum billing commitment; if customer churns within 30 days we claw back the discount on next invoice.

Marissa — can you please create the commercial addendum (include activation trigger language + contra-revenue accounting) and prep a DocuSign for Nimbus? I recommend we attach the mutual action plan Rishi drafted and include the HubSpot deal link.

Rishi — after Marissa prepares the addendum, route it to me for signature approval. I want to limit promo exposure to this deal id only: DL-2026-0897.

[Attachment: promo-approval-note.pdf (PDF, 36KB)]

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Sales Manager — Seed & Startup Programs
lauren_bishop@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0188
From: Emma Li <emma@nimbusteam.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Nimbus Labs Legal <legal@nimbusteam.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seed program promotional terms — extension request

Rishi / Lauren / Marissa — thanks for moving quickly and for the clarity. We can accept Option A with the 25% first-month discount (per Lauren's approval) and we'll proceed with getting the PO in within 30 days of the extended activation date. A couple of small asks before DocuSign: 

- Can the addendum specify that the activation credit applies only to host-region us-west-2? We have data locality constraints from the accelerator.
- For reporting, can Redwood include a monthly token-breakdown line on the invoicing for the first 3 months so we can reconcile usage vs. credit drawdown?

If that's all good, please send the DocuSign link and I will have our Legal sign the term sheet + addendum. We are targeting a soft launch in mid-August so the 60-day extension is critical.

[Attachment: signed-term-sheet-nimbus.pdf (PDF, 92KB)]

DocuSign preferred. HubSpot deal updated with PO target dates.

Best,
Emma Li
Head of Platform | Nimbus Labs
emma@nimbusteam.com
